questions.stem: Which OSI layer manages end-to-end communication and flow control?
questions.explanation: Layer 4 (Transport) manages end-to-end communication. TCP provides reliable delivery; UDP provides faster connectionless delivery.

choices.C: Providing VPN tunnels for remote users
choices.D: Logically segmenting networks to restrict broadcast domains and lateral movement

questions.explanation: VLANs create isolated logical groups, a compromised host in one VLAN cannot directly reach another without traversing a router or firewall.

choices.C: Isolate public-facing servers from both the internet and internal network

questions.explanation: A DMZ between two firewalls hosts public-facing services, preventing direct access from the internet to the internal LAN.

questions.stem: HTTPS provides security HTTP lacks by:

choices.B: Hiding the server IP via NAT
choices.C: Encrypting data in transit via TLS to ensure confidentiality and integrity

questions.explanation: HTTPS uses TLS to encrypt traffic between client and server, preventing eavesdropping and tampering.

choices.D: IP address, subnet mask, default gateway, and DNS server

questions.explanation: DHCP dynamically assigns all basic IP configuration, eliminating manual network setup for connected devices.

choices.B: Hiding internal IP addresses and preventing direct external addressing of internal hosts

questions.explanation: NAT translates private internal IPs to a public IP, hiding internal topology from external observers.

choices.C: Packet headers, source/destination IP, port, and protocol

questions.explanation: Packet-filtering inspects headers only, fast but cannot see application content or validate returning traffic.

questions.stem: A stateful firewall improves on packet filtering by:

choices.D: Tracking connection state and allowing only traffic matching established sessions

questions.explanation: Stateful firewalls maintain a connection table. Unsolicited inbound packets not matching established sessions are automatically dropped.

choices.B: Human-readable domain names to IP addresses

questions.explanation: DNS is the internet's directory service, resolving domain names to IP addresses on port 53.

choices.C: IP addresses to MAC addresses on the local network segment

questions.explanation: ARP maps a known IP address to the corresponding MAC address on the local segment, enabling frame-level delivery.
